briefExample.title: Example brief
briefExample.must: Valle d'Itria or the coast near Ostuni. Three bedrooms. Up to €650,000.
briefExample.nice: A pool, or room to add one. Sea view.
briefExample.never: A full restoration project. Next to a main road.

testimonials.title: [Real client testimonial]
testimonials.text: A quote from a buyer who completed a purchase with us: first name, home country, the area they bought in. Published only with their written consent.

testimonials.title: [Real client testimonial]
testimonials.text: A second story, ideally from a buyer who started differently (a video call, or a home found through a partner agency).

consult.title: Talk to a consultant
consult.text: Every situation is different. A consultant can look at yours and tell you which of these points apply, and who you need to involve.

legalNote.title: Indicative information
legalNote.text: This page explains how things usually work and quotes rates from Italian law as we understand them on the date shown. Rules and rates change and every purchase is different: confirm the figures for your case with the notary, a lawyer or a tax adviser before you rely on them.

draft.title: Draft page
draft.text: This page is a template. Sections marked [REAL DATA] still need local figures and notes from Oikos before it is published. It is excluded from search engines until then.

footer.statement: Tell us what you're looking for. We'll find it and guide you through the purchase.
footer.company: Buy House in Italy is a service of Oikos Immobiliare.
footer.registration: Estate agent registration: [REAL DATA: REA / Chamber of Commerce number]

consent.title: Your privacy choices
consent.text: We use storage on your device for what you ask the site to do, such as saving your interview answers. With your permission we also record where your visit came from (for example an ad or a partner site) so we know which channels bring buyers to us. No tracking runs until you choose.
consent.necessaryText: Remembers your privacy choices and the answers you give in the interview. Always on.
consent.analyticsText: Records the campaign, referring site and first page of your visit, and attaches them to your enquiry.
consent.marketingText: Records ad click identifiers (Google, Meta) so we can measure which ads bring enquiries.
